Triage: lands in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, `domain:cli` (`packages/create-objectstack` per the lane table); type `Task`. Routed by this session under the **maintainer direct-dispatch channel**, on the instruction quoted verbatim:

> 在 objectstack 提两个 issue，objectstack这些问题你都接手直接派发

**Held behind #16330 — deliberately not dispatched in parallel.** Both cards edit `packages/create-objectstack`, and both add an assertion to the same scaffold test, so batch independence forbids the pair in one batch. The five folding gates fail at gate ① (different defect shape, different fix), so this is serialisation rather than a fold. #16330 is in flight now; this card returns to selection when its PR lands.

Two notes for whoever takes it, so the round does not rediscover them:

1. **The route choice in "The ask" is an in-card decision, not a `needs_decision`.** Pick A or B, record which in the changeset, and say why in the PR body. Escalate only if both routes turn out to be wrong.
2. **Route A's trap is the symlinks.** `.claude/skills/*` are symlinks into `.agents/skills/`; ignoring `.agents/` while committing `.claude/` leaves a fresh cloner with dangling links. The acceptance criterion "cloning that commit yields readable `SKILL.md` files" is the one that catches it, and it is not satisfiable by a `_gitignore` edit alone.

Measured evidence for the duplication is in the body; it was reproduced end to end on `objectstack-ai/ats`, whose initial commit carried the bundle three times before it was cleaned up.

`domain:cli` seat #6024 is **not** being taken over by this session — see the routing note on #16330.

**PM note — a docs consequence the card did not scope, recorded before it is lost.** Not a rework instruction; the dev is in flight and its declared file surface (`packages/create-objectstack/`) correctly excludes these. This is the PM's scoping gap, and it is decided at review.

The docs-drift bot on PR #16401 says plainly that it cannot see this class: *"a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run."* So it was checked by hand.

`git grep -n -iE "skills add|--all" origin/main -- content/docs skills` at 2026-09-06T18:52Z. Six places teach `--all`; they split into two kinds, and only one kind breaks:

**Becomes factually false the moment this PR lands** — both state what the scaffolder *does*:

| Page | Line | Text |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` | 45 | "**Installs the AI skills bundle** (`npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --all`)" |
| `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` | 283 | "`npx skills add … --all` to keep the agent in …" |
| `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` | 57 | "runs `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --all` to install the AI skills …" |
| `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx` | 381 | same command, same claim |

**Stays true** — these teach `--all` as a *manual* command a user may still run, which Route B does not remove: `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx:35,38`, `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:27,30,33`, `skills/README.md:9`. They may deserve a nudge toward the narrower form, but they are not wrong, and `skills/README.md` is **governed surface** — touching it would move this PR onto the terminal four-step. Leave it alone.

So the required fix is two `content/docs/getting-started/*.mdx` files, neither of them governed.

**Why it should land with this PR rather than after.** The maintainer's standing principle on published docs (quoted on #15952): 「本项目以协议为基准」 — the published docs are part of what an app author, and every AI reading them, treats as the contract. A page that describes scaffolder behaviour the scaffolder no longer has is the same defect class this card is fixing, pointed at the docs. Shipping the change and leaving the description wrong trades one inconsistency for another.

It is also bounded: four lines across two files, no governed surface, no new gate family beyond the docs ones the diff already pulls in.

Decided at review, once the report lands.

**ACCEPT** — PR #16401, head `604dc4d2`, reviewed at 2026-09-06T19:00Z. One round.

Checklist: PR form ✓ (draft, base `main`, `Fixes #16331` first line) · changeset ✓ `create-objectstack` **minor**, correct for Route B · file surface ✓ **no breach** — all nine paths under `packages/create-objectstack/` plus the changeset · `content/docs/releases/**` untouched ✓ · governed slice empty ✓ · CI 32 checks, **0 red / 0 cancelled**, 18 success + 4 skipped, 10 still running.

## Spot readings taken against the tree

- **The modified pin is a strengthening, not a weakening.** The old case's first line asserted `REGISTRY_SOURCE` *text* contained the literal — that is the half that would have gone vacuous once the command was assembled from parts. Its second line, the actual leak guard (`not.toMatch(/skills add objectstack-ai\/objectstack(?!\/skills)/)`), **survives and now runs against the VALUE**. On top of that a new case forbids a second hand-written invocation, checking both `index.ts` and `skills-install.ts`, and asserts `index.ts` neither spells a repo-root install nor holds its own `execSync('npx…')`. Coverage went up.
- The `/skills` subpath boundary is intact: `SKILLS_CATALOG === 'objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills'`, and the command reads `npx -y skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --skill '*' --agent claude-code -y`. The comment correctly records why the boundary never depended on `--all`: `--skill '*'` includes `metadata.internal` entries either way.
- Route B is a **measured** choice, not a preference. Both Route A shapes were built, committed and cloned to reject them, and the naive one reproduced the trap named in triage exactly — 11 staged symlinks, 11 dangling in the clone, 0 readable `SKILL.md`. `--all --copy` was measured at 56 destination directories / 33.8 MB. The `core.symlinks=false` argument against committing symlinks is the one I had not thought of and is the stronger of the two.
- Clone verification was performed the way the card demanded — a real clone, not an argument: 11 staged `SKILL.md`, **0 staged symlinks**, 11 readable and **0 dangling** in a fresh clone, no `.agents/`, against a pre-fix control of 22 + 11.

## Three of my inputs corrected, all of them mine to own

`~1.6 MB` → **1,210,118 B**; "byte-identical" → 35 of 46 files are, the 11 `SKILL.md` differ by re-serialised frontmatter; `created-summary.ts`'s `49 · 49 · 11` → **46 · 46 · 11** today. None changes the defect, and leaving the 17.1.0 figure as labelled history while rewriting only its present-tense line is the right call.

## The docs question — I am reversing my own note above

[My earlier note](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/16331#issuecomment-5561376304) argued the two `getting-started` pages should land **with** this PR. **Withdrawn.** I wrote it without weighing the lane boundary: `content/docs/**` is `domain:devx`, so folding it in makes this a cross-domain PR, and a cross-domain single PR needs the triage seat to designate a lane rather than a `domain:cli` dispatch deciding for itself. The dev's decomposition is the protocol-correct one, and it found the same five surfaces independently.

The staleness is still real, so it must not rot: **#16400** goes user-visible-wrong the moment #16401 merges, because two of its five surfaces state what the scaffolder *does*. Flagged on that card.

Next: ready for review, then the merge queue once every check is green.
